name: Boomtect
description: Simulate the sound of lightning, blasts, and sonic booms from their physics. Shape a flash or a storm in 3D, place microphones over real terrain, and listen in stereo or binaurally, or export Ambisonics. Runs in the browser.

paragraphs: Boomtect simulates the sound of lightning, blasts, and sonic booms from their physics. Shape a flash or a whole storm in 3D above the ground, place microphones, and hear how distance, height, layered air, terrain, and ground shape what arrives. Listen in mono, as a spaced stereo pair, or binaurally on headphones, and export WAV or Ambisonics. Made for sound design, built on physics.
